impact_assessment.why: The operator wants a complete review of every change including gaps and better implementations, and points out the reviewer's context is far larger than the 16k cap
impact_assessment.benefits: A whole stage is reviewed in one request on a large-window model, nothing is dropped, and findings cover improvements not just defects
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PRINCIPLE-012 R1 gains a bounded exception and audit payload gains requests/budget; dependency: none new; concurrency: per-project lock unchanged; state: additive ai keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the 16k default for unknown models, split rather than drop on overflow, amend the rule with an ADR naming every citing principle, and test each path
